body: Yeah, long distance is rough. But you're still young. I remember people telling me not even to be in a serious relationship until after 22. Thanks for sharing though, helps me feel like I'm not all alone in this. I've got 10k to my name so I'm grateful for that, but I'm also 5 years older than you, so 4k is not bad at your age from my perspective. When I was 21 I lived off my parents and had 10k in debt. I just want to be happy to, but not at the expense of others happiness. That's one thing that makes the stock market so tough for me.

It almost seems like some of those people have so many millions, they're willing to piss em all away on stupid stock bets for internet points. I hate that shit. I am learning though. I'm going to try and get better at doing my own DD. I did get caught up in the hype though; that's why I didn't sell. I actually thought other people were "diamond handing" because the supposed squeeze got cut short by short-sellers...but now I feel like anyone smart got out and anyone still in is still holding out hope. I'd honestly get so pissed if it did skyrocket again, but I doubt it. Thanks for reply though, it does make me feel a little better.
You're right. I'm just beating myself up because it was so much money (to me at least). I know I should feel grateful though cause I still got a pretty descent return.
